findings.note: Name matches the 'stale' read-heuristic, but the RunE body mutates state via PUT /issues/{id}/archive/ when --confirm + --auto-archive-known and not --dry-run (stale_issues.go:168-175, applyStaleIssueArchive calls c.Put on /issues/{id}/archive/). Per tools-polish playbook: 'if the name matches the heuristic but the body actually mutates state, do NOT add the annotation.' --dry-run is the default and an IsVerifyEnv() guard forces willMutate=false in tests, but the production behavior with --confirm is a real write. The default destructive hint is correct.
